info.name: SugarCrumbs API (local)
info.description:
Local API for the SugarCrumbs baker backend (modular monolith on branch refactor/modular-monolith).

**No auth yet**: every endpoint is open until #10 lands.

**Suggested order:** Catalog → Create category → Create item; Availability → set working hours; Bookings → Create booking → Accept / Reject.

Ids from create requests are saved automatically into collection variables (categoryId, itemId, bookingId, blockedDateId). Dates (`tomorrow`, `dayAfterTomorrow`, `nextWeek`, `tzOffset`) are recomputed before every request. Booking times (`slotAt`, `rescheduleAt`) are picked from live availability, so the run can be repeated. Each run leaves its category, booked item and bookings in the DB: booked items can't be deleted until #14.

exec: // Recomputed before every request so dates are always in the future.
const plusDays = n => { const d = new Date(); d.setDate(d.getDate() + n); return d; };
// The server reads booking times in its own zone (same machine), so send the local offset.

item.name: Catalog (front page items)

request.description: Names must be unique. Saves `categoryId`.
Throwaway category for the delete request below. The main `categoryId` is kept because items and bookings later in the run depend on it. Saves `tmpCategoryId`.
Fails with 409 while items still use the category.
All filters are optional; enable any of them.

body.raw:
{
  "name": "Cinnamon Roll",
  "description": "Soft roll with cream cheese icing",
  "price": 4.5,
  "categoryId": "{{categoryId}}",
  "leadTimeHours": 0,
  "stockQuantity": 12
}

request.description: `stockQuantity: null` (or omitted) means unlimited stock. Saves `itemId`.
Unavailable items can't be booked.
Negative to decrement. Fails for unlimited-stock items.

Uploads `docs/postman/fixtures/sample-item.png` (path relative to the repo root: run the CLI from there, or set it as the Postman app working directory). PNG/JPEG/WEBP only, max 10MB. Uploaded files aren't served yet (#8).
409 if any booking references the item; mark it unavailable instead.

request.description: The Items folder deletes its item, so bookings get a fresh one (lead time 0, available). Saves `itemId`.

exec: // Pick the first bookable slot between tomorrow and next week, so repeated runs
// don't collide with slots taken by earlier runs (capacity is 1 per slot).
throw new Error('no bookable slot between tomorrow and next week: set working hours first');

request.description: `scheduledFor` must be the start of a bookable slot. Saves `bookingId`.
All filters optional; from+to must be used together.
PENDING → CONFIRMED
CONFIRMED → IN_PROGRESS
CONFIRMED/IN_PROGRESS → FULFILLED
